evidence.mechanism: shot-08s: strips curl into matching arcs with tips leaning right and the bend repeated down five rows; by shot-20s the top rows stay curled while the bottom rows reopen, so the base-to-tip wave reads only weakly.
evidence.ambition: shot-02s: 48 upright two-tone strips in an 8 by 6 grid; shot-08s: the same strips in arc form. One flat rendering idea (rust skin, dark fiber lines, nested segments), CSS only, with little visible layering behind the strips.
evidence.craft: shot-02s: clean cream ground, rust and graphite faces and crisp dark bases with no artefacts; the strips are thin and small, leaving large empty margins at shot-20s where the grid is inset.
evidence.distinctness: shot-08s: a cream and rust field of bent cards, sharing the cream editorial look of the climate spiral but not its subject or structure; no archive exists to compare against, so judged on the anchors.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: composed grid with only the bottom row starting to bend; by shot-20s the grid is inset and the top rows curl, but the frame does not clearly resolve into a final composed state.

pairwise_justification: No median archive exists yet, so there is no head-to-head reference and the check defaults to true.

critique.change: Enlarge the strips so the 12 segments and the base-to-tip lag are readable at shot-08s, and add a tip offset cue so the wave front shows as a moving line across the grid.
Add the brief's ochre tissue haze behind each strip, brightening and dimming with the wave, so the grid gains a second rendering layer instead of one flat strip style.
Resolve the 20s end state: reopen the top rows toward the cream margin so shot-20s differs clearly from shot-02s as a finished composition.
